digestAlgorithm: sha256(sorted relative schema path + NUL + raw generated JSON bytes + NUL)
reviewedChanges: CodexErrorInfo adds the string variant flexUnavailable. It appears in every thread, turn and error payload that embeds a turn error, which accounts for all changed thread and turn response files. xcb classifies flexUnavailable, like serverOverloaded, as a transient provider capacity failure (Failure::Transport, category 'provider capacity temporarily unavailable'), never as the account's usage limit, so it neither marks the account exhausted nor triggers quota failover.
PlanType adds promax in account, account-updated and rate-limit payloads. xcb treats the plan as bounded display text and does not enumerate plan values.
EnvironmentAddParams adds optional authBearerToken. The adapter never calls environment/add; thread environments stay empty.

Plugin responses drop the extension metadata types added in 0.157.1 (PluginEntrypoint, PluginExtensions, PluginIcon, PluginQuickAction, PluginQuickActionTarget, PluginSearchProvider, PluginSearchProviderCall, PluginSettings, PluginSummary.extensions). Plugins remain disabled and no plugin RPC is used.

Thread start, turn start, initialize and config/read request or response shapes used by the adapter are otherwise unchanged; the recorded echo trace differs from 0.157.1 only in timestamps and identifiers.

added: defer_mailbox_preemption: under development, default false; not enabled
changedDefaults: guardianv2.thread_context: stable/true -> removed/false; xcb still writes it false for the retained 0.157.1 build and 0.158.0 accepts and reads it back false

write_stdin_approval: under development/false -> stable/true; an approval gate on writes to exec sessions. Shell and unified exec stay disabled and the forged-builtin checks remain unsupported, so the gate is left at its default rather than removed

compatibility: Each reviewed version and executable digest selects its own exact schema; unknown catalog candidates must match the current release schema. The launch configuration is unchanged from 0.157.1. 0.158.0 passed the full scripted inventory and native boundary; retained 0.157.1 passed both again with this source.
